overview_description.description: Tall Poppy builds tools and services to help companies protect their employees against online harassment and abuse. It combines proactive security training, threat monitoring, and detection with incident response when an individual comes under attack. In addition to its standard service, it also offers additional capabilities for high-profile or executive staff who face increased risk.

about_short_description.short_description: Tall Poppy builds tools and services to help companies protect their employees against online harassment and abuse.

product.name: Digital Footprint Assessment
product.description: A service that analyzes employees' online presence to identify and remediate privacy risks before attackers can exploit them.

product.name: Advanced Security Review
product.description: A personalized security evaluation involving a detailed interview to assess and improve employees' personal security practices.

product.name: Digital Safety Training Workshop
product.description: A customizable training program that educates employees on digital safety, online harassment, and security best practices.

product.name: Incident Response Support
product.description: A service offering trauma-aware support and resources to employees experiencing online harassment or attacks.
